Completed controls.py check-in SYNTHETIC_DONE.json And it skips the calculations when the hashes match folder, So you don't have to automatically continue the big search, there's no big search, if the new synthetics are interrupted SYNTHETIC_PARTIAL.json separate request/result The completed set of this launch is already in SYNTHETIC.json. acceptance.py check-in solver, independent Python-cryptography, skipping the finished stage, byte reassembly of tables and hashes of read old inputs.

results/SPACES.json - exact coordinates, base, directions, All Equations and Certificate Numbers 436 boundless E1e-projections. GEOMETRY.csv geometry and comparison with E1d. E1D_GEOMETRY.json -all 78 narrow-space E1d, including parent spaces of later rejected sequels. HISTORY_UNIONS.json finite extension of stories with an exact lower bound on the number of candidates. TRANSFORM145.json - a real public entrance for conditional interval-DLP, without his decision. BLOCKS155.json - the exact eight intervals. COSTS.json - formulas and estimates of transfer. INPUTS.json, VERIFICATION.json, VERSIONS.json, FINAL_MANIFEST.json - reproducibility.
